gate.hold: when decremented $72 is nonnegative, return carry set
gate.limit: when local $64 is greater than or equal to local $62, return carry set
gate.advance: otherwise load local $72 from low byte of $66, increment local $64, return its value in A with carry clear

limitations: The local fields are not named as frames, duration, speed, or an action sequence without caller/runtime correlation.
Carry is preserved as a control-flow result; no browser animation state is changed from this fact alone.
The selector offset $002B is a native value, not an exported pose index.
